title: Clinic Coordinator
headline: Patient Scheduling and Front Desk
profile: Front desk professional with three years in a busy dental clinic, booking appointments, handling patient questions and insurance claims, and keeping records accurate.
letter: I'm applying for the Clinic Coordinator role at Harbourview Physiotherapy. Keeping a busy schedule full and making patients feel looked after from their first call is the work I did every day at Bright Smile Dental.
For three years I booked and confirmed around 60 appointments a day, rebooked cancellations from a waitlist, processed insurance claims and answered patient questions about billing and policies.

To be upfront: I haven't worked in a physiotherapy clinic and my French is basic. I learn new booking systems quickly and would welcome the chance to support your patients and therapists. Thank you for considering my application.
